versions.notes: SevenCode 1.0.27 — one Node bundle (3 475 382 bytes, sha256 91311f19a31f80196e36e32bcd217e745048ecf33d08f0bca61b3e70aedec5d1), which is why kind is `file` and one artefact serves every platform: the publisher serves the CLI as the single executable it is, and covey writes it rather than unpacking something of ours (#288). The digest is the one the publisher itself announces at /api/v1/cli/version, so it is theirs and not a measurement of ours. The address is `latest`, so a release upstream moves the bytes under a name that stays — that is why the version and the digest stand beside it and why a new release is a new entry rather than an edit. Fetching it needs a login, and one credential opens it: `COVEY_SEVENCODE_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN` — as a secret of the organisation, carried to the one install that needs it and stored nowhere (#289), or as a variable on the host that holds a token of its own, a mirror with nothing in covey behind it. One name for both doors, and the secret first, so an old export never shadows what somebody configured. `sevencode_api_token` is deliberately not the key here: that one is the engine's own runtime key, which the daemon hands to the sandbox as `SEVENCODE_API_KEY`, and a credential with two jobs gets rotated for one and breaks the other. A stored value needs no `Bearer` in front — the header is assembled as the endpoint wants it, from whatever the vendor handed out — and the digest, either way, is what decides whether the bytes may run. Whoever has no token points COVEY_ENGINE_CATALOG_URL at a catalogue of their own — the engine is then an image question, as it was before this document.

SevenCode 1.0.32 — one Node bundle (3 550 444 bytes, sha256 9ce4aa6504be2b751c79d956409f3aea6dc9aaa3c73894911cf7a65de9cd120a, as announced at /v1/cli/version and measured on download). The service moved from https://sevencode.app to https://sevenai.de/sevencode (#661): the old origin redirects to the new host but drops the /sevencode prefix, and the hop to another host loses the Authorization header, so neither the download nor a model call survives it. The paths under the new base carry no /api segment. The endpoint in `env` moved with it, and the egress allowlist of an agent on this engine has to name sevenai.de. Credentials as for 1.0.27: COVEY_SEVENCODE_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN opens the download, sevencode_api_token is the runtime key.
